PLAHIS Planning Application Reference: B2013/68306--- Address: Land Incorporating Gas Works, Zurich, Dex, Sovereign And Centre Link Houses, Magnet And Multi Storey Car Park287 - 323 High Street And Land FrontingCrown Road And Vale RoadSutton--- Proposal: Demolition of existing buildings/gas holders and redevelopment of the site for a mixed use retail/residential scheme comprising the construction of a Class A1 supermarket (12,221 sqm GEA/6,708 sqm net sales) above a car park providing 346 spaces fronting on Crown Road. The remainder of the site will comprise four principally residential buildings: a part six part thirteen storey building, with five retail units at ground floor (Class A1-A5 use) and 93 residential apartments above (twenty 1-bedroomed and seventy three 2 - bedroomed) located at the corner of Crown Road/High Street fronting on to a new public square, a part six part eleven storey building to the north fronting on to the High Street, comprising four retail units at ground floor (A1-A5 use) and seventy residential apartments above (eleven 1-bedroomed and fifty nine 2- bedroomed), two residential buildings fronting on to Vale Road comprising five 3 - bedroomed town houses with integral garages and 9 apartments (three 1- bedroomed and six 2 - bedroomed) and a separate building comprising nine apartments (three 1 - bedroomed, three 2 - bedroomed and three 3 - bedroomed) together with 32 residential car spaces accessed off Vale road.  An energy centre to provide a decentralised heat network incorporating Combined Heat & Power (CHP) along with photovoltaic panels will also be provided to serve the development.  Existing access points to the public highway are to be stopped up and the construction of a new access from the High Street to serve the development with a new service access from Crown Road to serve the supermarket only and a residential access from Vale Road.
